name: The City of Women
source:
This is the direct sequel to my game "[i]Master of the Earth: Reborn[/i]".

[b]You do not need to play that game in order to enjoy and understand this one.[/b]

Story:

You are transported to a world very similar to your original world.
In this world, men are slaves and biologically weaker than women.
Free men are second class citizens.
To make matters worst; the world is ruled by seven powerful super heroes each with unique powers and abilities to help them rule the world with an iron fist.
With the help of your new found friends you take up the mantle to become the most dangerous vigilante the world has ever seen. If successful it may lead to finding a way back to your original world.
It's time to embark on an epic adventure.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/the-city-of-women-v0-1-indianatk.131320]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
这是我的游戏“[i]Master of the Earth: Reborn[/i]”的直接续集。

[b]你不需要玩那个游戏才能享受和理解这个游戏。[/b]

故事：

你被传送到一个与你原来的世界非常相似的世界。
在这个世界上，男人是奴隶，在生理上比女人弱。
自由人是二等公民。
让事情变得更糟；世界由七位强大的超级英雄统治，每个英雄都拥有独特的力量和能力，可以帮助他们用铁拳统治世界。
在新朋友的帮助下，你将成为世界上最危险的治安维持者。如果成功的话，可能会找到回到原来世界的方法。
是时候开始一场史诗般的冒险了。
